name: isi_line
label: ISI line (three 1.65 m trucks in a row), reconfigurable spacings
sources: Hale et al. 2000, ApJ 537, 998: three mobile telescopes
notes: Three trucks in an East-West line at spacings (a, b) give the baselines a, b and a + b in one night: the schedule entries {spacings_m: [a, b]} set them per night, so a nine-night pair programme becomes three nights.
Default spacings 20 + 30 m (baselines 20, 30, 50 m) are a placeholder.
